Air mobile and plane movement ranges will lessen as your air superiority decreases.
column2: 制空权下降时，空中机动部队与飞机的移动范围会缩小。

column1: Air strikes can be used against enemy ground and air units.
column2: 空中打击可用于攻击敌方地面和空中单位。

column1: Fly a defensive air mission against an enemy helicopter to make it flee from the map.
column2: 对敌方直升机执行防御性空中任务，可迫使其逃离地图。

column1: Increase Air Superiority levels to help maintain your air mission points from turn to turn.
column2: 提高制空权等级，有助于逐回合保持你的空中任务点数。

column1: Light Infantry units ignore enemy zones-of-control.
column2: 轻步兵单位可无视敌方控制区。

column1: Planes may only resupply at friendly airfields and at Combat Support units.
column2: 飞机只能在友方机场或战斗支援单位处补给。

column1: Soften up entrenched units with artillery, air strikes, and ranged direct fire by certain tanks.
column2: 用炮击、空袭以及部分坦克的远程直射火力，削弱工事中的敌军。

column1: Taking enemy cities adds to your prestige and might earn you a leader, a new unit, or additional air points.
column2: 攻占敌方城市可增加威望，还可能为你赢得指挥官、新部队或额外空中点数。

column1: You can deploy from Combat Support units as long as they're not in an enemy zone of control.
column2: 只要战斗支援单位不在敌方控制区内，即可由其部署部队。
